task_scope: FactoryBench L1-L3 manufacturing telemetry tasks with item-specific scalar, tensor, ranking, Boolean, and MCQ outputs
applicability_conditions: No revised procedural rule is supported by improvements across both development folds

failure_taxonomy.description: Window-start selections did not reliably respect the requested phase definition, available samples, or complete-window requirement.
Boolean evaluations showed inconsistent application of stated operators, thresholds, and post-event temporal conditions.
One baseline response used an invalid Boolean character; the prior adapter corrected this isolated parse failure but did not yield stable cross-fold improvement.

fallback_policy: Use the original task specification without an additional adapter.
changes_from_previous: Remove the previous adapter because its improvement was limited to one development fold and was absent in the other fold.
Retain no specialized temporal, threshold, or formatting rule beyond the original task specification.
predicted_regression_risks: Removing the prior formatting reminder could reintroduce isolated parse failures.
Without the prior temporal-window reminder, unsupported phase-boundary assumptions may recur.
evidence_limitations: Development folds contain few items and heterogeneous formats.
The surrogate verifier disagreed with ground-truth outcomes on some items, limiting diagnosis reliability.
No holdout data, scores, outputs, or summaries were used.
